session-log.txt turns 25-28: dotnet build exposed CA1416 minimum-version warnings, then completed with zero warnings after TargetPlatformMinVersion was corrected.

tools_problematic.problem: The installed winapp CLI has no build subcommand, despite the migration skill instructing the agent to use it.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turn 25: "'build' was not matched" and the CLI command list omitted build.

tools_problematic.problem: It was launched concurrently with the build and therefore reported an unavailable layout before build output existed.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt turn 25: "No build output found under bin\x64\Debug - build the project first" while the parallel dotnet build later succeeded.

tool_limitations.limitation: The directory-only copy missed UWP project items linked from sibling SharedContent and shared directories, including App.xaml, MainPage, both scenario XAML files, styles, and assets.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Parse declared Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content items and materialize external files at their Link paths before namespace rewriting and triage.

tool_limitations.limitation: A clean build and process-alive smoke launch could pass while both feature pages exposed only an unavailable fallback.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Route known desktop-incompatible APIs through the unsupported inventory so validator cannot treat retained fallback-only code as a completed migration.

failed_apis.why_tried: The migration skill named it as the preferred compile command.
failed_apis.root_cause: The installed WinApp CLI supports run and packaging commands but not build.
failed_apis.fix: Use dotnet build with the target csproj.

failed_apis.why_tried: Both UWP scenarios use it for storage-item and in-memory protection at lock-state availability levels.
failed_apis.root_cause: The projection compiles in the packaged WinUI desktop process, but the manager is unavailable there and TryGetDefault returns null; the original code then hides all functional controls.
failed_apis.fix: Classify the API as unsupported during bootstrap and explicitly defer affected feature code rather than claiming an always-unavailable page is migrated.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md Step 3 and final build instruction
doc_errors.correct: Use dotnet build <project.csproj>; winapp has no build subcommand.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md statement that bootstrap is the complete inventory
doc_errors.wrong: The bootstrap inventory was treated as complete even though it only walked files physically under Source.
doc_errors.correct: Inventory must also materialize external files declared by the UWP csproj through Include and Link metadata.

special_apis.special_handling: Initialize each picker with the WinUI window HWND before calling its async picker method.
A successful compile does not establish desktop runtime support. TryGetDefault can return null and its AfterFirstUnlock/WhileUnlocked semantics have no desktop equivalent.

special_apis.api: Windows APIs guarded by SupportedOSPlatform metadata
special_apis.special_handling: Reconcile TargetPlatformMinVersion with both the UWP source minimum and retained API minimums; treat CA1416 as actionable rather than suppressing it.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold, bootstrap, and self-check were issued concurrently, so bootstrap ran before dotnet new completed.
errors_encountered.fix: Wait for scaffold completion, then run bootstrap, then run the self-check.

errors_encountered.root_cause: Each self-check raced the bootstrap command instead of waiting for it.
errors_encountered.fix: Execute the three bootstrap commands strictly sequentially.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The skill documented a nonexistent CLI subcommand.

errors_encountered.error: Test-AppLaunch status=unavailable: no build output under bin\x64\Debug
errors_encountered.root_cause: Launch validation raced the concurrent build.
errors_encountered.fix: Wait for a successful build before invoking Test-AppLaunch.ps1.

errors_encountered.error: CA1416 warnings for UserDataProtectionManager and UserDataAvailability
errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold minimum was Windows 10.0.17763 while the retained APIs require 10.0.18362 or later.
errors_encountered.fix: Raise TargetPlatformMinVersion to a supported version; the agent used 10.0.18362.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Bootstrap failed once and both mapping self-checks returned False despite bootstrap eventually succeeding.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 2 turns; one bootstrap retry and two premature self-checks
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Commands with explicit dependencies were parallelized.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The bootstrap was retried after scaffold completion and its successful output was used.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Execute scaffold, bootstrap, and Test-Path as strict sequential gates.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Source XAML appeared missing, so the agent searched obj output and manually reconstructed MainPage and both scenario pages.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: 9 turns from failed source globs through page reconstruction
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Bootstrap ignored csproj-linked files outside the supplied Source directory even though the project declared their Link paths.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent read generated obj XAML and recreated target XAML manually.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Materialize external project items from csproj Include/Link metadata during bootstrap.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: The preferred build command failed, launch validation raced the fallback build, and the first successful build emitted many CA1416 warnings.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Wrong build-command guidance, parallel build/launch ordering, and unclear minimum-OS reconciliation guidance.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: The agent switched to dotnet build, used dotnet run, raised TargetPlatformMinVersion, and reran validation.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Document dotnet build as the compile command, require build-before-launch ordering, and make TargetPlatformMinVersion reconciliation explicit.

missing_tooling.need: Bootstrap support for linked UWP project items
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire generated-XAML discovery and manual page reconstruction sequence while preserving original event wiring and resources.
A false successful migration in which all functional controls were hidden at runtime.

env_issues.issue: The installed winapp CLI version did not provide a build subcommand.
env_issues.workaround: Use dotnet build for compilation and Test-AppLaunch.ps1 or dotnet run for packaged launch.
